title: JSFL: enterEditMode, exitEditMode, runScript, runCommand, setTransformationPoint, align, space, match, transformSelection stubs
description:
Add no-op/stub implementations for 9 JSFL methods in packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts:

1. doc.enterEditMode(editMode?: string): void - console.warn('doc.enterEditMode: not supported, always on main timeline') + noop
2. doc.exitEditMode(): void - console.warn stub
3. fl.runScript(fileURI: string): void - console.warn('fl.runScript: not supported in browser context')
4. fl.runCommand(name: string): void - console.warn('fl.runCommand: not supported')
5. doc.setTransformationPoint(point: {x: number, y: number}): void - console.warn stub
6. doc.align(alignMode: string, bUseDocumentBounds?: boolean): void - console.warn('doc.align: not implemented') stub
7. doc.space(direction: string): void - console.warn stub
8. doc.match(bWidth: boolean, bHeight: boolean): void - console.warn stub
9. doc.transformSelection(a: number, b: number, c: number, d: number): void - console.warn stub

Add to appropriate interfaces (JsflDocument for doc.*, JsflFl for fl.*) and implementation objects. Keep all stubs minimal.
